scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && VITE_DSV_API_MODE=${VITE_DSV_API_MODE:-remote} vite build && node scripts/verify-static-server-contract.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:remote: CI=1 VITE_DSV_API_MODE=remote VITE_DSV_API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:3001 VITE_DSV_SHOP_DOMAIN=dsv-demo.local playwright test tests/e2e/remote-v1-boundary.spec.js tests/e2e/remote-tab-parity.spec.js tests/e2e/remote-inquiries.spec.js tests/e2e/remote-driver-reset-admin.spec.js tests/e2e/remote-driver-reset-public.spec.js
scripts.check: npm run test:static && VITE_DSV_API_MODE=mock npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:remote
